## Description

Brief description of the changes.

## Type of Change

- [ ] Bug fix (non-breaking change which fixes an issue)
- [ ] New feature (non-breaking change which adds functionality)
- [ ] Breaking change (fix or feature that would cause existing functionality to not work as expected)
- [ ] Documentation update
- [ ] Refactoring (no functional changes)

## Testing

- [ ] All tests pass (`python -m pytest -q`)
- [ ] New tests added for new functionality
- [ ] Code coverage maintained or improved (≥ 85%)
- [ ] Lint passes (`python -m ruff check src tests examples`)
- [ ] Type check passes (`python -m mypy src/itol_mcp`)

## Checklist

- [ ] Code follows the project style (ruff, line length 100)
- [ ] Self-review of code completed
- [ ] Docstrings / type hints added or updated
- [ ] Documentation updated (README.md / README_EN.md / docs/)
- [ ] CHANGELOG.md updated
